name: @dtconcepts/timds
description: Versioned CLI, contracts, templates, and AI skill for repository-owned TimDS design systems.

changes: The first template set: the articles collection and topic taxonomy in the seed, the article, topic and feed routes, the Portable Text serializer, the content contract and the handover checklist.

Installs into a Design System workspace as site/ with no pin, a secret-gated path for scheduled work beside the scheduled handler, bindings named without resource identifiers, and a hash of every installed file in .timds/emdash.json.
Declares article sections in sections.json with one shared field model, generated seeds, section routes and feeds, and mixed topic lists with per-collection cursors.
Exposes section contract 1 to builds, validates declarations against seeds, and derives preview routes and design references for every section.
Adds section contract 2 with nested literal address prefixes inside one Design System and rejects overlapping collection namespaces.
Shares the route inventory across builds, checks and previews, retaining explicit nonpublic design references and refusing collisions with public pages.

Requires the current first-release section contract, preserves immutable schemas through retries, and rejects static or native route collisions while retaining validated development routing and authored previews.
Allows an optional divisions.json in workspace sites to mount owner-authored pages, select a layout and design, and associate existing collections without changing their addresses or schemas.
Validates and exports the resolved composition as a separate versioned contract shared by development, consumer checks, previews and hosted builds.
Accepts verified offline inputs for pinned sibling Design Systems and publishes their passive styles and assets in a release-specific namespace.
Checks transitive composition sources and shared article components against their rendering contexts, refuses imported system styles, and preserves scoped family navigation.
Adds opt-in contact forms, durable delivery through Resend and Meta CAPI, and Meta Pixel, GA4 and Google Ads tags with configurable consent enforcement.
Adds the contact schema migration and hosted discovery tracking contract 1.
Makes the contact form browser script available across site pages and mounted previews, with support for shared layouts, dynamically inserted dialogs and submitter overrides.
Adds an explicit HTML content profile, exact-source rendering, site-owned article regions, related guides, video fields and structured article metadata for fresh sites.
Raises declared collection field capacity to 144 and adds per-site webhook delivery with contact attribution under tracking contract 2.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test .github/scripts/*.test.mjs src/*.test.mjs video/*.test.mjs && tsx --test video/*.test.tsx
